name: R-11 revision-5 first 24-hour bg-host embedding window: INCONCLUSIVE
command: Parse starts, exclusions, errorClass, and per-target completion counts as specified in method; compare with the committed baseline
summary: The first revision-5 24-hour window cannot be graded in full: its first 3h48m20s are absent from the retained system and user journals. In the observed portion, error-like lines per eligible sweep exceed the committed baseline (112/205 versus 74/266). This is a measured warning, not a claim about the missing interval or a full-window pass/fail rate.

window.coverageBasis: Both journalctl --list-boots and journalctl --user --list-boots begin with boot d02155aeac354b23898e7325f799da48 at 2026-10-02 00:41:49 EDT; journalctl --user returned zero lines for the missing interval. No full-window journal source was found.

runtime.continuousBuildCoverage: unknown because the start of the window has no retained journal

method.source: R-11 rubric revision 5; errorClass comes from r11-window-analysis.json
method.sweepBoundary: Each sweep starts at one [embed-backfill] sweep starting line and ends at the next such line or window end.
method.excludedSweeps: A sweep is excluded if it overlaps a sidecar Stopping/Starting event or contains a sidecar-reported database time-budget error.
method.parse: Parse the leading ISO timestamp and [embed-backfill] message from short-iso-precise journal lines. Count error-like messages only within eligible sweeps.

distinctObservedTemplates: a sweep has held the latch
formatStringCheck.result: all five templates occur in pre-extraction source; only the first three remain in eligible sweeps after rev5 exclusions

assertions.evidence: The first 13,700 seconds of the required window have no retained journal records.
Ten targets embedded rows in the observed portion, but there is no start-of-window missing-row snapshot, so the required proof is incomplete.
Every observed error-like template was found at 9a9473af95.
Observed portion 112/205 is above baseline 74/266; the exact full-window numerator and denominator are unavailable.

limitations: No start-of-window per-target missing-row snapshot is available; aggregate embedding counts cannot prove that each row missing at the start was embedded.
The observed error rate exceeds baseline, but absent early-window sweeps prevent the exact full-window ratio required by R-11.
Longer observed sweep durations accompany more budget-expired and latch-skip lines; this is correlation, not an established cause of the latency change.
